G5000.def:
Ταβειθά (Rec. Ταβιθά), ἡ (Aram. טַבְיְתָא or טְבִיתָא),
Tabitha: At 9:36, 40 (cf. Δορκάς).†
(AS)

G5001.def:
τάγμα, -τος, τό
(τάσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דֶּגֶל, also for חַי, רַגְלִי ;]
that which has been arranged or placed in order; esp. as military term, a company, troop, division, rank: metaphorically, 1Co 15:23 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G5002.def:
τακτός, -ή, -όν
(τάσσω), [in LXX: Jó 12:5 (שַׁאֲנָן) * ;]
ordered, fixed, stated: ἡμέρα, At 12:21,†
(AS)

G5003.def:
ταλαιπωρέω, -ῶ
(ταλαίπωρος), [in LXX Chiefly for שָׁדַד pu. ;]
__1. to do hard labour, suffer hardship or distress: Tg 4:9.
__2. In cl. occasionally trans., to weary, distress (so Sl 17:9, Is 33:1).†
(AS)

G5004.def:
ταλαιπωρία, -ας, ἡ
(ταλαίπωρος) [in LXX chiefly for שֹׁד ;]
__1. hard work (Hippocr.).
__2. hardship, suffering, distress: Rm 3:16 (LXX) pl., Tg 5:1 (see B1., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153).
(Hdt., Thuc., al.; and cf. MM, xxiv.)†
(AS)

G5005.def:
ταλαίωρος, -ον
[in LXX: Sl 137:8 (שָׁדַד), Is 33:1 (ποιεῖν τ., שָׁדַד), Tob.13:10, Wis.3:11, al. ;]
distressed, miserable, wretched: Rm 7:24, Ap 3:17.†
(AS)

G5006.def:
ταλαντιαῖος, -α, -ον
(τάλαντον),
__(a) worth a talent;
__(b) of a talent's weight: Ap 16:21.†
(AS)

G5007.def:
τάλαντομ, -ον, τ
[in LXX for כִּכָּר ;]
__1. a balance (Hom.).
__2. that which is weighed, a talent;
__(a) a talent in weight (in Horn. always of gold);
__(b) a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight (see DB, iii, 418 ff.): Mt 18:24 25:15 ff.†
(AS)

G5008.def:
ταλειθά (Rec. ταλιθά), (Aram. טְלִיתָא, see Dalman, Gr., 150),
talitha, i.e. maiden: Mc 5:41.†
(AS)

G5009.def:
ταμεῖον
(late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, Pr., 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό, [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר ;]
__1. a treasury (Thuc., al).
__2. a store-chamber (Arist., Xen.; Dt 28:8): Lc 12:24.
__3. an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 Is 26:20, al.): Mt 6:6 24:26, Lc 12:3.†
(AS)

G5010.def:
τάξις, -εως, ἡ
(τάσσω), [in LXX: Jó 38:12 (מָקוֹם), Sl 110:4 (דִּבְרָה), 2Ma.9:18, al. ;]
__1. an arranging, hence, in military sense, disposition of an army, battle array (Thuc., al.).
__2. arrangement, order (Plat., al): Lc 1:8.
__3. due order: Cl 2:5 (ICC, in l); κατὰ τάξιν, 1Co 14:40.
__4. office, order (for exx., see MM, xxiv): Hb 5:6 (LXX), Hb 5:6 6:20 7:11, 17" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5011.def:
ταπεινός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for שָׁפָל, עָנִי, etc. ;]
low-lying; metaphorically,
__(a) lowly, of low degree, brought low: Tg 1:9, 2Co 7:6 (cf. Sir.25:23); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, Lc 1:52; τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see ICC, in l), Rm 12:16;
__(b) lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually in a slighting sense (see Tr., Syn., § xlii; but see also Abbott, Essays, 81), in NT in an honourable sense: 2Co 10:1; before τ. καρδίᾳ, Mt 11:29 (cf. Sl 34:19); opposite to ὑπερήφανος, Tg 4:6, 1Pe 5:5" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5012.def:
ταπεινοφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(ταπεινόφρων)
lowliness of mind, humility: At 20:19, Ef 4:2, Fp 2:3, Cl 3:12, 1Pe 5:5; of a false humility, Cl 2:18, 23 (rare outside of NT, but found in bad sense in FlJ, BJ, iv, 9, 2; also in Epictet., see Tr., Syn., § xlii).†
(AS)

G5013.def:
ταπεινόω, -ῶ
(ταπεινός), [in LXX chiefly for עָנָה, also for שָׁפֵל, כָּנַע, etc. ;]
to make low: ὄρος (βουνόν), Lc 3:5 (LXX). Metaphorical, to humble, abase: Mt 18:4 23:12, Lc 14:11 18:14, 2Co 11:7 12:21, Fp 2:8; pass., Mt 23:12, Lc 14:11 18:14, Fp 4:12; id. with mid. sense, Tg 4:10, 1Pe 5:6.†
(AS)

G5014.def:
ταπείνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ταπεινόω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;]
abasement, humiliation, low estate: Lc 1:48, At 8:33" (LXX), Fp 3:21, Tg 1:10 (Plat., Arist., and later writers).†
(AS)

G5015.def:
ταράσσω
[in LXX for בָּהַל, רָגַז, etc., forty-six words in all ;]
to disturb, trouble, stir up: primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, Jo 1:5 [4], Jo 1:7. Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), to trouble, disquiet, perplex: At 15:24, Gl 1:7 5:10; ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l), Jo 11:33; of a crowd, to stir up, At 17:8, 13; pass., Mt 2:3 14:26, Mc 6:50, Lc 1:12 24:38, Jo 12:27 (Sl 6:4) Sl 14:1, 7, 1Pe 3:14" (LXX) ; τ. πνεύματι, Jo 13:21 (cf. δια-, ἐκ-ταράσσω)
(AS)

G5016.def:
ταραχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ταράσσω), [in LXX for חָלָה, מְהוּמָה, etc. ;]
trouble, disturbance: τ. ὕδατος, Jo 1:5 [4]. In pl. (as in cl.), tumults: Mc 13:8, Rec.†
(AS)

G5017.def:
τάραχος, -ου, ὁ
(ταράσσω), [in LXX for מְהוּמָה, etc. ;]
later form of ταραχή (Xen., al.; see Thackeray, Gr., 159): At 12:18 19:23.†
(AS)

G5020.def:
ταρταρόω, -ῶ
(Τάρταρος, a Greek name for the underworld, esp. the abode of the damned),
to cast into hell: 2Pe 2:4 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G5021.def:
τάσσω
[in LXX chiefly for שׂוּם, also for צָוָה pi., נָתַן, etc. ;]
primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order: with dative (accusative) and inf. (Bl., § 72, 5), At 15:2 18:2 (διατ-, WH) At 22:10; ἑαυτούς, 1Co 16:15; pass., Mt 8:9 (T [WH], R, txt., om.), Lc 7:8, Rm 13:1; ὅσοι ἦσαν τεταγμένοι εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον (perh. in mid. sense; see EGT and Page, in l), At 13:48; mid., to appoint for oneself or by one's own authority, Mt 28:16, At 28:23.†
(AS)

G5022.def:
ταῦρος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוֹר ;]
a bull: Mt 22:4, At 14:13, Hb 9:13 10:4.†
(AS)

G5027.def:
ταφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(θάπτω), [in LXX chiefly for קָבַר and cognate forms ;]
burial: Mt 27:7 (Hdt., al.; for other meanings, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 355 f., MM xxiv).†
(AS)

G5028.def:
τάφος, -ου, ὁ
(θάντω), [in LXX chiefly for קֶבֶר ;]
__1. a burial (Hom., al.).
__2. a grave, tomb (Res., Hdt., al.): Mt 23:27, 29 27:61, 64 27:66 28:1, Rm 3:13" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5029.def:
τάχα
(ταχύς),
adv., [in LXX: Wis.13:6 14:19 * ;]
__(a) (chiefly poët.), quickly, presently;
__(b) perhaps: Rm 5:7, Phm 15.†
(AS)

G5030.def:
ταχέως
(ταχύς)
adv., [in LXX chiefly for מְהֵרָה and cognate forms ;]
quickly, hastily: Lc 14:21 16:6, Jo 11:31, 1Co 4:19, Fp 2:19, 24, 2Tm 4:9; with suggestion of rashness, Gl 1:6, 2Ts 2:2, 1Tm 5:22.†
(AS)

G5031.def:
ταχινός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Pv 1:16, Hc 1:6, Is 59:7 (מָהַר), Wis.13:2, Sir.11:22 18:26 * ;]
poët. and late for ταχύς, swift: of swift approach, 2Pe 1:14 2:1.†
(AS)

G5032.def:
τάχειον, see: ταχύ.
ταχύ
(neut. of ταχύς),
adv., [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;]
quickly, speedily, forthwith: Mt 5:25 28:7-8, Mc 9:39, Lc 15:22, Jo 11:29, Ap 2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2 o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): Jo 13:27 20:4, 1Tm 3:14 (T, Rec.), Hb 13:19, 23 Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), At 17:15.†
(AS)

G5034.def:
τάχος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for parts and derivatives of מָהַר ;]
swiftness, speed. Adverbially, ἐν τ. (ταχέως), quickly, speedily, soon: Lc 18:8, At 12:7 22:18 25:4, Rm 16:20, 1Tm 3:14, Ap 1:1 22:6.†
(AS)

G5035.def:
ταχύ
(neut. of ταχύς),
adv., [in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;]
quickly, speedily, forthwith: Mt 5:25 28:7-8, Mc 9:39, Lc 15:22, Jo 11:29, Ap 2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2 o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): Jo 13:27 20:4, 1Tm 3:14 (T, Rec.), Hb 13:19, 23 Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), At 17:15.†
(AS)

G5036.def:
ταχύς, -εῖα, -ύ
[in LXX chiefly for מָהַר pi. ;]
quick, swift, speedy: opposite to βραδύς, Ja 119.†
(AS)

G5037.def:
τέ,
enclitic copulative particle (= Lat. -que as καί = and, ac, atque, not very frequently in NT, more than two-thirds of the occurrences being in Ac.
__1. τέ solitarium, and, denoting a closer affinity than καί between words and sentences which it connects (BL, §77, 8): Mt 28:12, Jo 4:42, At 2:33, 37 40 10:22 11:21, al.
__2. Denoting a closer connection than simple καί, τὲ . . . καί, τὲ καί, τὲ . . . τέ (At 26:16 Rm 14:8), as well . . . as also, both . . . and: Lc 12:45, At 1:1 15:9, 21:30, al.; τὲ . . . δέ, and . . . and, At 19:2; τὲ γάρ . . . ὁμοίως δὲ καί, Rm 1:26, 27.
(AS)

G5038.def:
τεῖχος, -ους, τό
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹמָה ;]
a wall, esp. that about a town: At 9:25, 2Co 11:33, Hb 11:30, Ap 21:12-19 †
(AS)

G5039.def:
τεκμήριον, -ου, τό
(τέκμαρ, a mark, sign), [in LXX: Wis.5:4 19:13, 3Ma.3:24 * ;]
a sure sign, a positive proof: At 1:1-26 (for exx., see MM, xxiv).†
SYN.: ἔνδειγμα, q.v (AS)

G5040.def:
τεκνίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of τέκνον),
a little child: as a term of endearment, in voc. pl., Jo 13:33, Gl 4:19, 1Jo 2:1 Jn 2:12 Jn 2:28 Jn 3:7 Jn 3:13 Jn 4:4 Jn 5:21.†
(AS)

G5043.def:
τέκνον, -ου, τό
(τίκτω), [in LXX chiefly for בֵּן, also for יֶלֶד, etc. ;]
that which is begotten, born (cf. Scottish bairn), a child of either sex: Mc 13:12, Lc 1:7, At 7:5; pl., Mt 7:11, Mc 7:27, Lc 1:17, Ef 6:1, al.; τέκνα ἐπαγγελίας, Rm 9:8; τ. τῆς σαρκός, ib.; in a wider sense (as Heb. בָּנִים), of posterity, Mt 2:18, Lc 3:8, al.; specif., of a male child, Mt 21:28, At 21:21, a,l.; in voc. as a form of kindly address from an elder to a junior or from a teacher to a disciple, Mt 9:2 21:28, Mc 2:5, Lc 2:48; τ. μου (= cl. τ. μοι; see Bl., §37, 5), Gl 4:19 (τεκνία, WH, txt.), 2Tm 2:1. Metaphorical,
__(a) of disciples (apart from direct address, see supr.): Phm 10, 1Tm 1:2, Tt 1:4, 3Jo.4;
__(b) with reference to the Fatherhood of God (see: πατήρ, γεννάω), τέκνα τ. θεοῦ (cf. Is 30:1, Wis.16:21): Rm 8:16, Ef 5:1, Fp 2:15; and esp. in Johannine bks. (cf. Westc, Epp. Jo., 94, 120), Jo 1:12, 1Jo 3:1 al.;
__(with) of those who imitate others and are therefore regarded as the spiritual offspring of their exemplars: Mt 3:9, Lc 3:8, Jo 8:39, Rm 9:7, 1Pe 3:6; τ. διαβόλου, 1Jo 3:10;
__(d) as in Heb. (LXX, Jl 2:23, Sl 149:2, 1Ma.1:38), of the inhabitants of a city: Mt 23:37, Lc 13:34 19:44, Gl 4:25;
__(e) with an adjectival genitive, frequently rendering a Heb. expression, adopted from LXX or formed on the analogy of its language, but sometimes with parallels in Gk. writers (see Deiss., BS, 161ff.): τέκνα φωτός, Ef 5:8; τ. ὑπακοῆς, 1Pe 1:14; κατάρας, 2Pe 2:14; ὀργῆς, Ef 2:3.
SYN.: see: παῖς. (AS)

G5044.def:
τεκνο-τροφέω, -ῶ
to rear young (of bees, Arist.),
to bring up children: 1Tm 5:10.†
(AS)

G5045.def:
τέκτων, -ονος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חָרָשׁ ;]
an artificer in wood, stone or metal, but esp. a carpenter (see MM, xxiv): Mt 13:55, Mc 6:3.†
(AS)

G5046.def:
τέλειος, -α, -ον
(τέλος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלֵם, תָּמִים and cogn. forms ;]
having reached its end, finished, mature, complete, perfect;
__1. of persons, primarily of physical development,
__(a) full-grown, mature: Hb 5:14; ethically: Fp 3:15; opposite to νήπιος (-άζειν), 1Co 2:6 14:20, Ef 4:13; τ. καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι, Cl 4:12; τ. ἐν Χριστῷ, Cl 1:28;
__(b) complete, perfect (expressing the simple idea of complete goodness, without reference either to maturity or to the philosophical idea of a τέλος; see Hort on Tg 1:4): Mt 5:48 19:21, Tg 1:4 3:2; of God, Mt 5:48.
__2. Of things, complete, perfect: Rm 12:2; ἔργον, Tg 1:4; νόμος, Tg 1:25; δώρημα, Tg 1:17; ἀγάπη, 1Jo 4:18; τὸ τ., 1Co 13:10; compar., τελειοτέρα (σκηνή), Hb 9:11.
(There is probably no reference in St. Paul's usage to the use of this term in the ancient mysteries; cf. ICC on Cl 1:28; but see also Lft., in l, and Notes, 173 f.) †
SYN.: see: ὁλόκληρος (and cf. Rendall, He., 158 ff.) (AS)

G5047.def:
τελειότης, -ητος, ἡ
(τέλειος), [in LXX: Jz 9:16, 19 (תָּמִים), Pv 11:3 (תֻּמָּה), Wis.6:15 12:17, Jr 2:2 * ;]
perfection, completeness: Cl 3:14, Hb 6:1
(AS)

G5048.def:
τελειόω, -ῶ
(τέλειος), [in LXX: Êx 29:9, Lv 4:5, al. (τ. χεῖρ מָלֵא pi.), 2Rs 22:26, al. (תָּמַם), Wis.4:13, al. (cf. Westc., He., 64) ;]
__1. bring to an end, finish, accomplish, fulfil: Jo 4:34, At 20:24; of time, Lc 2:43, Jo 5:36 17:4; pass., ἡ γραφή, Jo 19:28.
__2. to bring to maturity or completeness, to complete, perfect;
__(a) of things: Hb 7:19, Tg 2:22, 1Jo 2:5 Jn 4:12 Jn 4:17 :
__(b) of persons, in ethical and spiritual sense: Hb 2:10 9:9 10:1, 14; pass., Lc 13:32, Jo 17:23, Fp 3:12, Hb 5:9 7:28 11:40 12:23, 1Jo 4:18 (for a different view of the meaning in Hb 2:10, al., see Rendall, in l).†
(AS)

G5050.def:
τελείωσις, -εως, ἡ
(τελειόω), [in LXX chiefly for מִלֻּא, Êx 29:22, al. ;]
fulfilment, completion, perfection: Lc 1:45, Hb 7:11.†
(AS)

G5052.def:
τελεσφορέω, -ῶ
(τέλος, φέρω) [in LXX: 4Ma.13:20 * ;]
__(a) of plants, to bring fruit to perfection (Theophr.): Lc 8:14
__(b) of females, to bear perfect offspring (Artemid.; 4Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G5053.def:
τελευτάω, -ῶ
(τελευτή), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;]
__1. trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die (Æsch., Hdt., al.).
__2. Intrans., to come to an end, hence, to die (Hdt., al.): Mt 2:19 9:18 22:25, Mc 9:48, Lc 7:2, Jo 11:39, At 2:29 7:15, Hb 11:22; Hebraistically, θανάτῳ τελευτάτω (מוּת, Êx 21:17), Mt 15:4, Mc 7:10" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G5054.def:
τελευτή, -ῆς, ἡ
(τελέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוּת, מָוֶת ;]
__1. a finishing.
__2. an end: τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, death (Hdt., Plat., al.): Mt 2:15.†
(AS)

G5055.def:
τελέω, -ῶ
(τέλος), [in LXX for כָּלָה, pi., etc. ;]
__1. to bring to an end, complete, finish: τ. δρόμον, 2Tm 4:7; τ. λόγους, Mt 7:28 19:1 26:1; τ. παραβολάς, Mt 13:53; τ. πόλεις, Mt 10:23; pass., Ap 15:8 20:3, 5 20:7; with ptcp., Mt 11:1.
__2. to execute, perform, complete, fulfil: Lc 2:39, At 13:29, Rm 2:27, 2Co 12:9, Gl 5:16, Tg 2:8, Ap 11:7; pass., Lc 12:50 18:31 22:37, Jo 19:28, 30, Ap 10:7 15:1 17:17.
__3. to pay (frequently in cl.): Mt 17:24, Rm 13:6
(cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-τελέω).†
(AS)

G5056.def:
τέλος, -ους, τό
[in LXX for קֵץ, etc.; εἰς τὸ τ., chiefly for נֶצַח and cognate forms ;]
__1. end: most frequently of the termination or limit of an act or state (in NT also of the end of a period of time, cl. τελευτή), Lc 1:33, 1Co 10:11, 2Co 3:13, 1Pe 4:7; by meton., of one who makes an end, Rm 10:4; ἕως (ἄχρι, μέκρι) τέλους, 1Co 1:8, 2Co 1:13, Hb 3:14 6:11, Ap 2:26; εἰς τ., to or at the end, Mt 10:22, Mc 13:13, Lc 18:5, Jo 13:1 (or here, to the uttermost, see Westc., in l); τ. ἔχειν, Lc 22:37; adverbially, τὸ δὲ τέλος, finally, 1Pe 3:8; of the last in a series, Ap 21:6 22:13; of the issue, fate or destiny, Mt 26:58; with genitive of thing(s), Rm 6:21, al.; with genitive of person(s), 2Co 11:13, al.; of the aim or purpose, 1Tm 1:5.
__2. toll, custom, revenue: Rm 13:7; pl., as most usually, Mt 17:25
(AS)

G5057.def:
τελώνης, -ου, ὁ
(τέλος, ὠνέομαι)
__1. a farmer of taxes (Let. publicanus).
__2. A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer (EV, publican): Mt 5:46 10:3, Lc 3:12 5:27, 29 7:29 18:10-11, 13; pl., τ. κ. ἁμαρτωλοί, Mt 9:10-11 11:19, Mc 2:15-16, Lc 5:30 7:34 15:1; τ. κ. πόρναι, Mt 21:31-32; ὁ ἐθνικὸς κ. ὁ τ., Mt 18:17 (cf. DB, iv, 172; ext., 394 f.; MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G5058.def:
τελώνιον, -ου, τό
(τελώνης),
a custom house (so in MGr.), tollhouse, place of toll: Mt 9:9, Mc 2:14, Lc 5:27.†
(AS)

G5059.def:
τέρας, -ατος, τό
[in LXX chiefly for מוֹפֵת ;]
a wonder, marvel: in NT always pl., τ. κ. σημεῖα, Mt 24:24, al. (see: σημεῖον)
(AS)

G5062.def:
τεσσεράκοντα (Rec. τεσσαρ-, v, WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 45 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 62 f., 73 f.), οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl.,
forty: Mt 4:2, Mc 1:13, Lc 4:2, Jo 2:20, At 1:3, al
(AS)

G5063.def:
τεσσερακονταετίς
(Τ, -έτης; Rec. τεσσαρ-, see supr.), -ές
of forty years, forty years old: At 7:23 13:18.†
(AS)

G5064.def:
τέσσαρες
(and Ion. and late -ερεν, and late accusative -εν; see WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 36, 45 f.), οἱ, αἱ, -αρα, τά, genitive, -ων,
four: Mt 24:31, Mc 2:3, Lc 2:37, Jo 11:17 19:23, At 10:11, Ap 4:4, 6, al
(AS)

G5066.def:
τεταρταῖος, -α, -ον
(τέταρτος), [in LXX: 2Rs 3:4 A (רְבִיעִי) * ;]
of or on the fourth day: τ. εἶναι (Hdt., τ. γενέσθαι), to be four days dead, Jo 11:39.†
(AS)

G5067.def:
τέταρτος, -η, -ον
[in LXX chiefly for רְבִיעִי ;]
fourth: Mt 14:25, Mc 6:48, At 10:30, Ap 4:7 6:7-8 8:12 16:8 21:19.†
(AS)

G5068.def:
τετράγωνος, -ον
(τετρα-, see supr., + γωνία), [in LXX for רָבַע and cogn. forms ;]
square: Ap 21:16 (Hdt., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G5069.def:
τετράδιον, ου, τό
a quarternion, a group of four: στρατιωτῶν, At 12:4 (Philo).
(AS)

G5072.def:
τετράμηνος, -ον
[in LXX (neut.): Jz 19:2 A Jz 20:47 A (עַרְבָּעָה חֳדָשִׁים ) * ;]
of four months, four months; as subst., τ. (sc. ὥρα, but neut. in Rec.), Jo 4:35 (Thuc., al.).†
(AS)

G5074.def:
τετρά-πους, -ουν
[in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה ;]
four-footed: of beasts, neut. pl., At 10:12 11:6, Rm 1:23.†
(AS)

G5075.def:
τετρααρχέω (Rec. τετραρχ-; see WH, App., 145), -ῶ
(τετραάρχης),
to be tetrarch: with genitive, Lc 3:1 (FlJ, BJ, iii, 10, 7).†
(AS)

G5076.def:
τετραάρχης (Rec. τετράρχης, see supr.), -ου, ὁ
(τετρα- in corp. = τέτορα, Doric for τέσσαρα, + ἄρχω),
a tetrarch, i.e.
__(a) prop., the governor of a fourth part of a region (Strab.);
__(b) any petty ruler (Plut.); in NT, of Herod Antipas: Mt 14:1, Lc 3:19 9:7, At 13:1.†
(AS)

G5077.def:
τεφρόω, -ῶ
(τέφρα, ashes; Wis.2:3, al.),
to burn to ashes: 2Pe 2:6.†
(AS)

G5078.def:
τέχνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for חׇכְמָה, מַעֲשֶׂה, עֲבֹדָה ;]
art, craft, trade: At 17:29 18:3, Ap 18:22 (WH, R, mg., om.).†
(AS)

G5079.def:
τεχνίτης, -ου, ὁ
(τέχνη), [in LXX for חָרָשׁ, etc. ;]
a craftsman, artificer: At 19:24, 38, Ap 18:22; of God (Wis.13:1), Hb 11:10.†
SYN.: δημιουργός, which see, and cf. Tr., Syn., § cv (AS)

G5080.def:
τήκω
[in LXX for מָסַס ni., מָקַק ni., מוּג ni., etc. ;]
trans.,
to melt, melt down; pass., to melt, melt away: 2Pe 3:12.†
(AS)

G5081.def:
τηλαυγῶς
adv. (τῆλε, afar, + αὐγή, radiance), poët. and in late prose,
at a distance clearly: Mc 8:25 (W, mg., δηλαυγῶς).†
(AS)

G5082.def:
τηλικοῦτος, -αύτη, -οῦτο
(altern. of τηλικόσδε, -ήδε, -όνδε, strength­ened form of τηλίκος), [in LXX: 2Ma.12:3, 3Ma.3:9, 4Ma.16:4 * ;]
__1. of persons,
__(a) of such an age, so old;
__(b) so young.
__2. Of things, so great: 2Co 1:10, Hb 2:3, Tg 3:4, Ap 16:18.†
(AS)

G5083G.def:
τηρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
__1. to watch over, guard, keep, preserve: Mt 27:36, At 16:23, al.; ἑαυτόν, 2Co 11:9, 1Tm 5:22, Tg 1:27, Ju 21; before εἰς, Jo 12:7, At 25:21, 1Pe 1:4, 2Pe 2:4 2:9 3:7, Ju 6; ἐν, Jo 17:11-12, Ju 21; ἐκ, Jo 17:15, Ap 3:10; τ. πίστιν, 2Tm 4:7, Ap 14:12; τ. ἑνότητα τ. πνεύματος, Ef 4:3.
__2. to watch, give heed to, observe: τ. σάββατον, Jo 9:16; τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), Mt 19:17, Jo 14:15 15:10, 1Tm 6:14, 1Jo 2:3-4 Jn 3:22 Jn 3:24 Jn 5:3, Ap 12:17 14:12; τ. λόγον (-ους), Jo 8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6, 1Jo 2:5, Ap 3:8, 10 22:7, 9; τ. νόμον, At 15:5, Tg 2:10; τ. παράδοσιν, Mc 7:9; τ. ἔργα, Ap 2:26; τ. γεγραμμένα, Ap 1:3 (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω)
SYN.: φυλάσσω, implying custody and protection: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word) (AS)

G5083H.def:
τηρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
__1. to watch over, guard, keep, preserve: Mt 27:36, At 16:23, al.; ἑαυτόν, 2Co 11:9, 1Tm 5:22, Tg 1:27, Ju 21; before εἰς, Jo 12:7, At 25:21, 1Pe 1:4, 2Pe 2:4 2:9 3:7, Ju 6; ἐν, Jo 17:11-12, Ju 21; ἐκ, Jo 17:15, Ap 3:10; τ. πίστιν, 2Tm 4:7, Ap 14:12; τ. ἑνότητα τ. πνεύματος, Ef 4:3.
__2. to watch, give heed to, observe: τ. σάββατον, Jo 9:16; τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), Mt 19:17, Jo 14:15 15:10, 1Tm 6:14, 1Jo 2:3-4 Jn 3:22 Jn 3:24 Jn 5:3, Ap 12:17 14:12; τ. λόγον (-ους), Jo 8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6, 1Jo 2:5, Ap 3:8, 10 22:7, 9; τ. νόμον, At 15:5, Tg 2:10; τ. παράδοσιν, Mc 7:9; τ. ἔργα, Ap 2:26; τ. γεγραμμένα, Ap 1:3 (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω)
SYN.: φυλάσσω, implying custody and protection: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word) (AS)

G5083I.def:
τηρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
__1. to watch over, guard, keep, preserve: Mt 27:36, At 16:23, al.; ἑαυτόν, 2Co 11:9, 1Tm 5:22, Tg 1:27, Ju 21; before εἰς, Jo 12:7, At 25:21, 1Pe 1:4, 2Pe 2:4 2:9 3:7, Ju 6; ἐν, Jo 17:11-12, Ju 21; ἐκ, Jo 17:15, Ap 3:10; τ. πίστιν, 2Tm 4:7, Ap 14:12; τ. ἑνότητα τ. πνεύματος, Ef 4:3.
__2. to watch, give heed to, observe: τ. σάββατον, Jo 9:16; τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), Mt 19:17, Jo 14:15 15:10, 1Tm 6:14, 1Jo 2:3-4 Jn 3:22 Jn 3:24 Jn 5:3, Ap 12:17 14:12; τ. λόγον (-ους), Jo 8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6, 1Jo 2:5, Ap 3:8, 10 22:7, 9; τ. νόμον, At 15:5, Tg 2:10; τ. παράδοσιν, Mc 7:9; τ. ἔργα, Ap 2:26; τ. γεγραμμένα, Ap 1:3 (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω)
SYN.: φυλάσσω, implying custody and protection: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word) (AS)

G5084.def:
τήρησις, -εως, ἡ
(τηρέω), [in LXX: Wis.6:18, (Sir.32:23), 1Ma.5:18, 2Ma.3:40, 3Ma.5:44 * ;]
__1. a watching, hence, imprisonment, ward (see Deiss., BS, 267): At 4:3 5:18.
__2. a keeping: τ. ἐντολῶν (cf. Sir, Wis, ll. with, and see Westc. on 1Jo 2:3.), 1Co 7:19.†
(AS)

G5085G.def:
Τιβεριάς, -άδος, ἡ
(Τιβέριος),
Tiberias, a city of Galilee: Jo 6:23, Jo 6:1 21:1 (cf Γεννησσαρέτ, Γαλιλαία).†
(AS)

G5085H.def:
Τιβεριάς, -άδος, ἡ
(Τιβέριος),
Tiberias, a city of Galilee: Jo 6:23, Jo 6:1 21:1 (cf Γεννησσαρέτ, Γαλιλαία).†
(AS)

G5087.def:
τίθημι,
[in LXX for שִׁית ,נתן ,שׂוּם, etc. ;]
__1. causative of κεῖμαι,
__(a) to place, lay, set: Lc 6:48, Rm 9:33, al.; of laying the dead to rest, Mc 15:47, Lc 23:55, Jo 11:34, At 7:16, al.; before ἐπί, with genitive, Lc 8:16, Jo 19:19, al.; id. with accusative, Mc 4:21, 2Co 3:13, al.; ὑπό, Mt 5:15, al.; παρά, At 4:35, 37. Mid., to have put or placed, to place for oneself: of putting in prison, At 4:3, 5:18, 25, al.; of giving counsel, βουλήν, At 27:12; of laying up in one's heart, Lc 1:66 21:14 ( 1Rs 21:12);
__(b) to put down, lay down: of bending the knees, τ. γόνατα, to kneel, Mc 15:19, At 7:60, al.; of putting off garments, Jo 13:4; of laying down life, τ. ψυχήν, Jo 10:11, 15 17, 18 13:37, 38 15:13, 1Jo 3:16; of laying by money, παρ ̓ ἑαυτῷ, 1Co 16:2; of setting on food, Jo 2:10; metaphorically, of setting forth an idea in symbolism, Mc 4:30.
__2. to set, fix, establish: ὑπόδειγμα, 2Pe 2:6.
__3. to make, appoint: Mt 22:44, Mc 12:36, Lc 20:43, At 2:35, Rm 4:17, al. Mid., to make, set or appoint for oneself: At 20:28, 1Co 12:28, 1Ts 5:9, 1Tm 1:12, al.; before ἵνα, Jo 15:16 (cf . ἀνα-, προσ-ανα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἀντι-δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπο-τίθημι).
(AS)

G5088.def:
τίκτω
[in LXX chiefly for יָלַד ;]
prop., of parents,
to beget, bring forth, but esp. the latter, and so always in NT: absol., Lc 1:57 2:6, Jo 16:21, Gl 4:27" (LXX) (see M, Pr., 127), Ap 12:2, 4; υἱόν, Mt 1:21, 23 1:25 Lc 1:31 2:7, Ap 12:5, 13; pass., Mt 2:2, Lc 2:11. Metaphorical, of the earth, βοτάνην, Hb 6:7 (Æsch., al.); of lust, ἁμαρτίαν, Tg 1:15.†
(AS)

G5089.def:
τίλλω
[in LXX: Et 9:3, Is 18:7, Dan LXX 7:4 (מָרַט) * ;]
to pluck, pluck off: στάχυας, Mt 12:1, Mc 2:23, Lc 6:1.†
(AS)

G5090.def:
Τιμαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Aram. טִימַי (?), see Zorell, see word),
Timæus: Mc 10:46.†
(AS)

G5091.def:
τιμάω, -ῶ
(τιμή), [in LXX for כָּבַד pi., עָרַךְ hi., etc. ;]
__1. to fix the value, price: with accusative of person(s), of Christ, Mt 27:9 (LXX).
__2. to honour: with accusative of person(s), Mt 15:4 (LXX), Mt 15:5, 8" (LXX) Mt 19:19 (LXX), Mc 7:6, 10 10:19, Lc 18:28" (LXX), Jo 5:23 8:49 12:26, Ef 6:2" (LXX), 1Tm 5:3, 1Pe 2:17; πολλαῖς τιμαῖς, At 28:10.†
(AS)

G5092.def:
τιμή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for עֵרֶךְ, יְקָר, etc. ;]
a valuing, hence, objectively;
__1. a price paid or received: with genitive of person(s), Mt 27:9; with genitive of thing(s), At 5:2-3; pl., At 4:34 19:19; τ. αἵματος, Mt 27:6; ἠγοράσθητε τιμῆς, 1Co 6:20 7:23; ὠνεῖσθαι τιμῆς ἀργυρίου, At 7:16.
__2. esteem, honour: Rm 12:10 13:7, 1Co 12:23, 1Tm 5:17 6:1, Hb 5:4, 1Pe 2:7 (R, txt., preciousness, cf. Hort, in l), 1Pe 3:7; τ. διδόναι, 1Co 12:24; ἔχειν, Jo 4:44, Hb 3:3; τ. καὶ δόξα (δ. κ. τ.), Rm 2:7, 10, 1Tm 1:17, Hb 2:7" (LXX), Hb 2:9, 1Pe 1:7, 2Pe 1:17, Ap 4:9, 11 5:12-13 7:12 21:26; τ. καὶ κράτος, 1Tm 6:16; εἰς τ., Rm 9:21, 2Tm 2:20-21; ἐν τ., Cl 2:23; 1Ts 4:4; by meton., of marks of honour, At 28:10.†
(AS)

G5093.def:
τίμιος, -α, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX chiefly for יָקָר ;]
valued, hence,
__(a) precious, costly, highly valued: primarily, of money value, λίθος, Ap 17:4 18:12, 16 21:19; pl., 1Co 3:12; compar., -ώτεφος, 1Pe 1:7, Rec.; superl., -ώτατος, Ap 18:12 21:11; in extended sense, καρπός, Tg 5:7; αἷμα, 1Pe 1:19; ἐπαγγέλματα, 2Pe 1:4;
__(b) held in honour, honoured, esteemed worthy: with dative, At 5:34; ὁ γάμος, Hb 13:4; ψυχή, At 20:24 (where τ. is pleonastic, see Page, in l).†
(AS)

G5094.def:
τιμιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(τίμιος),
preciousness, worth: Ap 18:19 (cf. Hort on τιμή, 1Pe 2:7).†
(AS)

G5097.def:
τιμωρέω, -ῶ
(τιμή + οὖρος, a guardian) [in LXX: Eze.5:17 14:15 (שָׁכֹל pi), Wis.12:20 18:8, al. ;]
__1. to help.
__2. to avenge; mid., to avenge oneself on, punish (Hdt., Eur., al): act, in this sense, At 22:5 26:11 (see MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G5098.def:
τιμωρία, -ας, ἡ
(τιμωρέω), [in LXX: Pv 24:22 (פִּיד), etc. ;]
__1. help, assistance.
__2. vengeance, punishment: Hb 10:29.†
SYN.: κόλασις, which see, and cf. MM, xxiv (AS)

G5099.def:
τίνω
[in LXX: Pv 27:12 (τ. ζημίαν, for עָנַשׁ ni.), etc. ;]
to pay: t. δίκην (cf. Pr, l.with), to pay penalty, 2Ts 1:9 (see M, Th., in l).†
(AS)
